scope: Notion delegation -> persisted Qwen coding subagent restart identity

finding.summary: Stable taskId/batchId alone is insufficient for persisted Qwen delegation. Qwen includes sessionPrefix in the persisted batch execution signature, while the coding-subagent runner generates a random sessionPrefix when the caller does not provide one. A restarted Notion->Qwen adapter that reuses the same batchId but omits a deterministic sessionPrefix will hit QWEN_SUBAGENT_BATCH_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH before it can observe/resume done, running, or uncertain task state.
qwen_contract: subagent-batch-store ensure() rejects an existing batchId when its signature differs
finding.notion_contract: DelegationRequest currently carries stable task_id/parent_turn_id/conversation_key but no Qwen-specific restart identity. The future Qwen adapter therefore must derive every persisted Qwen identity deterministically rather than relying on Qwen defaults.

offline_reproduction.environment: ChatGPT hosted Python; no provider/CI/network execution
offline_reproduction.fixture: same task/model/settings/batch identity, two different random-style sessionPrefix values
offline_reproduction.consequence: existing batchId would be rejected as QWEN_SUBAGENT_BATCH_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH

requirements: all three values must remain identical after process restart
retryUncertain must remain false unless an explicit owner/recovery decision enables it
adapter must not create a fresh batchId/sessionPrefix to escape uncertain/running state
max_model_turns above Qwen HARD_MAX_ROUNDS must be rejected or explicitly negotiated, never silently weakened
successful Qwen result with empty text must preserve completed status rather than cause a fresh execution

recommended_owner_fix: Implement the deterministic mapping in the future Qwen delegation adapter and add a restart regression that creates a persisted uncertain/running batch, reconstructs the adapter, and proves the same taskId/batchId/sessionPrefix reaches the existing record. Do not change Qwen persistence semantics merely to hide the adapter identity bug unless Qwen Core explicitly chooses that API contract.
